items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: We process orders same-day and ship via UPS/FedEx. Most orders arrive within 2-3 business days. Expedited shipping is available at checkout.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Yes! Free shipping on all orders over $100. For orders under $100, standard shipping is $5.99. Express and overnight shipping options available.

items.question: What's your return policy?
items.answer: 30-day money-back guarantee on all products. If you're not satisfied for any reason, we'll issue a full refund including original shipping. See website for exceptions.

items.question: Are all products authentic?
items.answer: 100% authentic. All products are purchased directly from manufacturers or authorized distributors. We guarantee authenticity or your money back.

items.question: Do you offer volume discounts?
items.answer: Yes! Orders of 10+ units receive volume pricing. Contact our sales team at sales@quickcart.io for custom quotes and enterprise pricing.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: A tracking number will be emailed to you as soon as your order ships. You can also track your order in your QuickCart account dashboard.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use industry-leading SSL encryption, PCI compliance, and Stripe's security standards to protect your personal and payment information.
